listen.quelle: Ergänzende Informationen zum LehrplanPLUS – Gymnasium, Englisch, Jahrgangsstufen 11–13: Grundstock von Operatoren, Kompetenzbereich Schreiben (Stand 02.11.2021), Staatsinstitut für Schulqualität und Bildungsforschung München (ISB), 2021

operatoren.definition: describe and explain in detail
beispiele:
Analyze the way(s) in which atmosphere is created.
Examine the opposing views on social class held by the two protagonists.

operatoren.definition: express a well-founded opinion on the nature or quality of sb./sth.
beispiele:
Assess the importance of learning languages for somebody’s future.
Evaluate the success of the steps taken so far to reduce pollution.

operatoren.definition: provide a thorough analysis of a character
beispiele: Give a characterization of the protagonist in the excerpt.

operatoren.definition: state one’s opinion clearly and support one’s view with evidence or reasons
beispiele: Comment on the writer’s view on gender roles.

operatoren.definition: show similarities and differences
beispiele: Compare the opinions on education held by the experts presented in the text.

operatoren.definition: give a detailed account of what sb./sth. is like
beispiele: Describe the soldier’s outward appearance.

operatoren.definition: give arguments or reasons for and against, especially to come to a well-founded conclusion
beispiele: Discuss whether social status determines somebody’s future options.

operatoren.definition: make sth. clear
beispiele: Explain the protagonist’s obsession with money.

operatoren.definition: use examples to explain or make clear
beispiele: Illustrate the way in which school life in Britain differs from that in Germany.

operatoren.definition: explain the meaning or purpose of sth.
beispiele: Interpret the message of the cartoon.

operatoren.definition: give the main features, structure or general principles of sth.
beispiele: Outline the writer’s views on love, marriage and divorce.

operatoren.definition: present the main aspects of sth. briefly and clearly
beispiele:
Point out the author’s ideas on…
State your reasons for applying for a high school year.

operatoren.definition: give a concise account of the main points or ideas of a text, issue or topic
beispiele:
Summarize the text.
Sum up the information given about green energy.

operatoren.definition: produce a text with specific features
beispiele: Write the ending of the story / a letter to the editor / a dialogue, etc.

listen.quelle: Gemeinsame Abituraufgabenpools der Länder – Aufgaben für das Fach Englisch – Grundstock von Operatoren (Stand 21.11.2024, gilt ab Prüfungsjahr 2027), bereitgestellt auf LehrplanPLUS (Englisch 12/13), IQB / Länder; bereitgestellt vom ISB auf LehrplanPLUS, 2024

operatoren.definition: describe and explain in detail and give evidence from the text, relating the content to relevant aspects of language and form
beispiele:
Examine how Jennifer Senior conveys her attitude towards “cancel culture” and its consequences for authors. Focus on structure and use of language.
Analyze the way the protagonist is characterized. Focus on narrative techniques and use of language.
Analyze how the author’s opinion on social movements is conveyed. Focus on use of language and communicative strategies as well as the function of the photo published with the article.

operatoren.definition: express a well-founded opinion on the relative value, quality or significance of sth., i.e. on the extent to which sth. is effective/true/etc., backing up one’s argumentation with evidence and examples
beispiele:
Assess to what extent the cartoon reflects what Choudhury and his family have experienced in the US.
Taking the cartoon as a starting point, evaluate the effectiveness of measures taken against discrimination in the US.
Taking the quotation as a starting point, assess to what extent educational institutions can help young people realize their potential.

operatoren.definition: express a well-founded opinion on sth., backing up one’s argumentation with evidence and examples and possibly considering counterarguments
beispiele:
Comment on the writer’s admission that his view might be seen as “anti-American” (l. 21).
Comment on the message of the cartoon with respect to what makes good journalism in the 21st century.

operatoren.definition: explain similarities and differences and give evidence from the text, relating the content to relevant aspects of language and form
beispiele: Compare how the issue of racism is presented in the two articles. Focus on communicative strategies and the use of language.

operatoren.definition: give a detailed account of what sb./sth. is like
beispiele: Describe the old woman and her behavior.

operatoren.definition: express a well-founded opinion on sth., considering arguments for both sides of an issue, backing up one’s argumentation with evidence and examples
beispiele:
“[S]he would be the first one to join up […] and work for the cause, bleed for the cause, make the cause the central purpose of her life.” (Paul Auster, 4 3 2 1, ll. 57-60) Using Amy’s plea as a starting point, discuss the idea of devoting one’s life to a cause.
The author talks of “the influencer game” (l. 41). Taking the article as a starting point, discuss whether the influencer phenomenon is really a “game”.

operatoren.definition: make sth. clear by referring to the text and its context to clarify how or why sth. is as it is
beispiele:
Explain the protagonist’s reservations about the concept of the American Dream.
Explain how the statistics complement the author’s point of view.

operatoren.definition: give a concise account of the main points or ideas of a text, issue or topic as specified by the task
beispiele:
Outline the information on the life of African Americans in the 1960s as presented in the text.
Summarize the information on the narrator’s husband.
Sum up Bono’s view on the European Union and his vision for its future.

operatoren.definition: present the main aspects of sth. briefly
beispiele: Point out the effects of climate change on low-lying countries and the measures taken to deal with the situation.

operatoren.definition: produce a text with characteristic features
beispiele:
Write a letter to the editor, commenting on the author’s view on technology and his vision of the future.
“For me, education was power.” (Michelle Obama) Former First Lady Michelle Obama is African American, a successful lawyer and the first academic in her family. Write a blog entry for the website of the international youth project Knowledge – Voice – Action, in which you assess to what extent Michelle Obama’s claim holds true for minorities and the socially disadvantaged.

zusatz.Fußnote: Außer dem Operator „write“ und der zu erstellenden Textsorte präzisiert ein weiterer Operator die Anforderungen an den zu verfassenden Text.

operatoren.definition: give a concise account of the main points or ideas of a text as specified by the task, clarifying culture-related aspects if necessary
beispiele:
Write an article for the project website, outlining the development and the goals of “Jugend forscht”.
Write an email to your friend in which you present the Muldestausee youth council and its accomplishments.
For their blog, write an entry summing up the information on Danny Beuerbach and his initiatives.

operatoren.definition: produce a text with characteristic features, clarifying culture-related aspects if necessary
beispiele: Your American friend is active in the National Junior Firefighter Program and is interested in how other countries organize firefighting and what challenges they are facing. Write your friend an email in which you present the situation of firefighting in Germany.

zusatz.Fußnote: Außer dem Operator „write“ und der zu erstellenden Textsorte präzisiert ein weiterer Operator die Anforderungen an den zu verfassenden Text.

operatoren.operator: agree on, come to an agreement
operatoren.definition: come to one opinion or an understanding based on arguments
beispiele:
Come to an agreement on what to be included in your presentation.
Agree on two pictures which could persuade your age group most to do more for the protection of the environment.

operatoren.definition: describe, explain and give evidence from the material
beispiele:
For a youth conference on American ideals, visions and traditions, you have been asked to give an oral presentation about the cartoon. Analyze the cartoon.
You are preparing a photo exhibition for an international youth convention on the topic City Environments. Analyze the photographs.

operatoren.definition: make a case based on appropriate evidence for and/or against some given point of view
beispiele: In a discussion about the replacement of textbooks by portable computers at school argue for or against this proposal.

operatoren.definition: express a well-founded opinion on the relative value, quality and significance of sb./sth., i.e. arguing about the extent to which sth. is effective/true/etc., backing up one’s argumentation
beispiele:
Assess the suitability of the two cartoons to illustrate your topic.
Evaluate the chances for an applicant’s personal development described in the job offer at hand.

operatoren.definition: provide a well-founded opinion on sth., backing up one’s argumentation and possibly considering counterarguments
beispiele:
As members of your school’s student council you and your partner are expected to organize a panel discussion on the importance of moral issues in today’s society. Comment on the following statistics.
The EU has launched a competition entitled Mobility for all. Entries should propose both creative and realistic regional projects. Comment on the material.
Comment on the relevance of the issue covered in the cartoon for (our) society.

operatoren.definition: explain similarities and differences
beispiele:
Based on the charts, compare the job situation of young people your age in Germany and in the UK.
You are preparing a photo exhibition for an international youth convention on the topic of City Environments. Compare the aspects of city life shown in the photos.

operatoren.definition: give a detailed account of what sth./sb. is like
beispiele: You and your partner are participating in an international youth convention on environmental challenges. You are looking for photographs to illustrate your presentation. Describe the pictures to your partner.

operatoren.definition: give/exchange arguments or reasons for and against a particular view or idea, backing up one’s argumentation and drawing a well-founded conclusion (together)
beispiele:
You and your partner are participating in a youth convention about robotics. Together with your partner, discuss the benefits and challenges of further scientific innovations.
Together with your partner, discuss whether options such as community service, gap years, or military service should be mandatory for young people.
Discuss the problems shown in the photos and possible solutions.

operatoren.definition: make sth. clear by referring to examples and its wider context if necessary
beispiele:
Explain the following quotation about travelling.
Explain possible reasons behind the statistics and the impact on both the individual and society.

operatoren.definition: propose initiatives, measures, etc. and explain why they need to be taken
beispiele: Make suggestions on how discrimination against marginalized groups can be fought. Rank them according to effectiveness.

operatoren.definition: show the relationship between materials, concepts, etc. by explaining whether/how two or more texts oppose, complement or contradict each other
beispiele: Relate the two cartoons to each other.

beispiele: Zählen Sie drei zentrale Elemente einer Demokratie auf.

operatoren.definition: Kenntnisse (Fachbegriffe, Daten, Fakten, Modelle) und Aussagen in kurzer Form unkommentiert wiedergeben
beispiele: Nennen Sie alle Oppositionsfraktionen im derzeitigen Bundestag.

operatoren.definition: Kenntnisse (Fachbegriffe, Daten, Fakten, Modelle) und Aussagen in kurzer Form unkommentiert wiedergeben
beispiele: Geben Sie ein bekanntes Argument für die relativ hohen Diäten von Abgeordneten wieder.

operatoren.definition: Vorgegebenes (bspw. Modelle) begrifflich präzise, in der Regel mit Fachbegriffen, benennen
beispiele: Beschriften Sie folgendes Schaubild zum politischen System von (…) sinnvoll.

operatoren.definition: wesentliche Aspekte eines Sachverhaltes wiedergeben

operatoren.definition: wesentliche Aspekte eines Sachverhaltes wiedergeben

operatoren.definition: Erklärung eines Begriffs inhaltlich präzise wiedergeben
beispiele: Definieren Sie den Begriff Föderalismus.

operatoren.definition: Elemente in eine sinnvolle Reihenfolge bringen, um beispielsweise einen Ablauf darzustellen
beispiele: Sortieren Sie folgende Schritte des Gesetzgebungsverfahrens sinnvoll.

operatoren.definition: Materialien (z. B. Textquellen) oder Sachverhalte kriterienorientiert oder aspektgeleitet erschließen, in systematische Zusammenhänge einordnen und Hintergründe und Beziehungen herstellen
beispiele: Analysieren Sie das vorliegende Schaubild (EU) in Hinblick auf die demokratischen Mitwirkungsmöglichkeiten eines EU-Bürgers (drei Aspekte).

aus vorliegenden Materialien bestimmte Sachverhalte herausfinden, um eine vorgegebene Position oder Aussage zu unterstützen

operatoren.definition: Ursachen, Abläufe oder Folgen von Sachverhalten deuten und nachvollziehbar darstellen

operatoren.definition: Ursachen, Abläufe oder Folgen von Sachverhalten deuten und nachvollziehbar darstellen
beispiele: Erläutern Sie anhand der aktuellen Regierungskoalition den möglichen Ablauf eines Konstruktiven Misstrauensvotums.

operatoren.definition: Sinnzusammenhänge aus Materialien (z. B. Karikaturen) erschließen und zu einer Aussage kommen
beispiele: Interpretieren Sie mit Bezug auf die Bildelemente die Aussage der Karikatur.

operatoren.definition: Sachverhalte gegenüberstellen, um Gemeinsamkeiten, Ähnlichkeiten und Unterschiede herauszufinden
beispiele: Vergleichen Sie anhand des Schaubildes die Stellung des Bundespräsidenten mit der Stellung des Präsidenten der Französischen Republik.

operatoren.definition: Verbindung zwischen Material oder Aussage und einem bestimmten Beispiel oder Sachverhalt herstellen
beispiele: Ordnen Sie folgende Szenarien den entsprechenden Konjunkturphasen zu.

operatoren.definition: einen Sachverhalt reflektiert und argumentativ schlüssig bestätigen/widerlegen
